brief_text: Use gravity 9.81 m/s2, contact friction 0.72, restitution 0.04, hinge damping 0.04 N m s/rad, and slide damping 0.20 N s/m; start every body from rest. Balls are 0.10 m diameter and 0.20 kg, dominoes are 0.08 by 0.04 by 0.24 m and 0.25 kg, carts are 0.22 by 0.18 by 0.10 m and 0.50 kg, blocks are 0.12 m cubes and 0.35 kg, ramps are 1.00 m long and 0.30 m wide at 20 degrees, and horizontal rings have 0.16 m clear diameter.
